status: Diagnosed bug, C++ fix and new runtime tests not performed
expected: An Open returned practice room with capacity accepts an ordinary new connection, including a player who previously left; no old-round identity restoration promised.
reported: Client leaves Results, Host returns to preparation, same Client joins again and briefly appears then returns to Entry.
source_trace: HALPracticeRoomGameMode::InitGame consumes TakeRoundTravel and sets bRestoringTravel=true.
HALPracticeRoomGameMode::HandleStartingNewPlayer treats bRestoringTravel as a per-player restore context and rejects missing Travel.Players identity.
UE5.8.2 GameModeBase::PostLogin calls HandleStartingNewPlayer before the subclass HALMatchGameMode::PostLogin reaches Room.AddMember.
New connection lacks imported old PlayerKey; the exact error text is sent by the restore branch.
fix_direction: Separate normal login from genuine seamless-player restoration; normal admission only in Open. Preserve restore identity checks and delayed old clients; do not merely clear the global flag on first arrival.
regression_needed: Results client leave, host return, same client fresh join and next round.
Brand-new third player joins the returned room.
Remaining delayed seamless client restores correctly.
workaround: Host closes and recreates room, then Client joins.
mutation_scope: Existing documentation updated and this evidence added only. Source/config/assets unchanged; no commit or push.
